title: Assemble stratifications of a constructible immersed partition
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $(\iota_i:Y_i\to X)_{i<n}$ be a finite family of immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose images are constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset], pairwise disjoint and cover $X$. For every $i$ let $T_i$ be a finite constructible locally closed scheme stratification of $Y_i$ [def-constructible-stratification]. Let $P$ be any predicate on scheme morphisms into $X$, and assume $P$ holds for every composite $(T_i)_b\to Y_i\to X$. Then there is a finite constructible locally closed scheme stratification $R$ of $X$ such that $P$ holds for every stratum immersion of $R$.

source.place: Tag 03S0 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), final refinement in the proof; Tag 09YJ (lemma-constructible-in-constructible), https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03S0 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YJ

proof.text: Index the new strata by the dependent sum of the finite local index sets and reindex by Fin of its cardinality. Take the given local domain schemes and composite immersion maps. Immersions compose, and their images are locally closed.

Identify each outer scheme homeomorphically with the image of its immersion. Transfer constructibility of its local stratum to that image. The image is constructible in X, and X has a basis of quasi-compact opens, so constructibility in a constructible subspace gives constructibility in X.

Covering follows by first choosing an outer stratum and then a local stratum. Different outer pieces give disjoint composite images; within one piece use injectivity of its immersion and disjointness of the local strata. These data form the required LocallyClosedStratification. Each predicate proof is the given hP because the domains and maps were taken literally from the local data. Empty index sets are included.

theorem exists_stratification_of_stratified_partition {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (n : ℕ) (Y : Fin n → Scheme.{u}) (ι : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X)
    (hι : ∀ i, IsImmersion (ι i))
    (hc : ∀ i, Topology.IsConstructible (Set.range (ι i)))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i k ↦ Disjoint (Set.range (ι i)) (Set.range (ι k))))
    (hu : (⋃ i, Set.range (ι i)) = Set.univ)
    (T : ∀ i, LocallyClosedStratification (Y i))
    (P : ∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, (Z ⟶ X) → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ i b, P ((T i).domain b) ((T i).immersion b ≫ ι i)) :
    ∃ R : LocallyClosedStratification X,
      (∀ k, Topology.IsConstructible (R.stratum k)) ∧
      ∀ k, P (R.domain k) (R.immersion k)
